native_prompt:
Make a targeted edit. In the lower left erase only the small right-pointing black arrow between the envelope and the loose green-triangle role token. Keep both objects and the long curved arrow from the loose token to the orange claim tile, and keep the board-to-log arrow. There must be exactly those two arrows. Lower the uppermost outer ring arc modestly so its rim has at least 40 final pixels of clear top margin; preserve the Public claims lettering position and size. Preserve all six labels, the two phase sectors and all other mechanisms.

Render one finished static factual editorial illustration for a premium advanced textbook. Use a 1200 by 630 wide native composition; white ground, crisp dark ink, restrained indigo, teal, and terracotta highlights, clean modern large sans-serif, high-contrast flat editorial linework with subtle cutaway shading. Fill the broad white canvas with the mechanism without adding bars or shrinking a different aspect ratio. At least 12 individually useful objects and at least two visually differentiated substages. No human figures, avatars, shields, gears, logos, brands, realism, pseudo-text, microstrokes, invented gauges, controls or success marks.

Circular voting board at center, opaque role packet nook at left, transcript inspection station to right, isolated lower scope qualifier.

Anonymous abstract game pieces only, no humanoids. Role packet and sleeve reveal a colored geometric role token; its right-hand port reaches a claim-tile pocket on the outer board, representing selective claims rather than disclosure of the role itself. Add round board, phase divider, public claim markers, recessed ballot slot and separate night token vault. One line from the discussion-record port on the board at x785 y250 to the review station's sequence tray inlet at x862 y250. Use opaque shaped transcript tokens, a comparison lens and open inspection pocket. Ring boundary is not an arrow.

Private roles do not become public ground truth. No arrow to workplace reliability, universal deception risk or a numerical leaderboard.

Visible text allowlist, exactly once per label and no other text: "Private roles", "Public claims", "Day vote", "Night action", "Review the log", "Game results only". Labels sit on white, never on a connector. Detached caveat occupies its own clean box and never participates in flow. Hold 52px planning inset from every edge; retain at least 40px whitespace to actual glyphs after export. Use the region and label boxes with font minima specified below, and attach every arrow tail and head to the exact exposed object port, clear of labels, frames and unrelated objects. Only the enumerated arrows are directional.
